steps.tx: Excess prolactin suppressing GnRH and causing amenorrhoea with galactorrhoea is **hyperprolactinaemia**. Prolactinomas, drugs and hypothyroidism head the causes. A single non stressed morning sample usually suffices to detect it. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Hyperprolactinaemia suppresses GnRH causing amenorrhoea with galactorrhoea.

steps.tx: The preferred dopamine agonist with weekly dosing and better tolerance is **cabergoline**. It normalises prolactin and shrinks most prolactinomas without surgery. Bromocriptine is the older alternative preferred when conception is planned by some. Correlating this finding with imaging and laboratory results prevents both delayed treatment and unnecessary intervention in most patients.
steps.say: Cabergoline normalises prolactin weekly and shrinks most prolactinomas.

steps.tx: Intrauterine adhesions after curettage obliterating the cavity cause **Asherman syndrome**. Periods lighten or vanish despite normal hormones. Hysteroscopic division restores menstruation and fertility in most. Early recognition matters because timely treatment gives clearly better outcomes than waiting for complications to develop first.
steps.say: Asherman syndrome scars the cavity after curettage despite normal hormones.

steps.tx: Macroprolactin, a biologically inactive big form, falsely elevates assays, termed **macroprolactin screening**. Laboratories precipitate it with polyethylene glycol on request. It explains high prolactin without symptoms or tumour. Students should connect this fact with the presenting symptoms, since examination questions usually test that clinical link directly.
steps.say: Macroprolactin screening explains high prolactin without symptoms by inactive big forms.

steps.tx: Large prolactinomas compressing the optic chiasm cause bitemporal hemianopia needing **visual field testing**. MRI sizes the adenoma before treatment. Cabergoline usually shrinks even giant tumours dramatically. Documenting this finding clearly in the notes guides the next clinician and supports safe, well planned further management.
steps.say: Visual field testing guards large prolactinomas compressing the optic chiasm.

steps.tx: Pregnancy expands prolactinomas, so conception planning stops cabergoline at the positive test in microadenomas, following **pregnancy planning rules**. Macroadenomas may continue it. Visual symptoms in pregnancy earn urgent MRI without gadolinium. When this picture is seen in practice, urgent senior review is wise whenever there is any doubt about severity.
steps.say: Pregnancy planning stops cabergoline in microadenomas at the positive test.

steps.tx: Hysterosalpingogram or saline sonography outlines Asherman adhesions, but hysteroscopy both diagnoses and treats, termed **hysteroscopic adhesiolysis**. A balloon or coil prevents readhesion while oestrogen rebuilds lining. Repeat look procedures are common. Understanding this mechanism explains the symptoms, the investigation findings and the logic behind each step of treatment given.
steps.say: Hysteroscopic adhesiolysis treats Asherman adhesions with balloon prevention of recurrence.

steps.tx: Drug induced hyperprolactinaemia from antipsychotics or metoclopramide needs psychiatric liaison before stopping, a **drug cause pathway**. Switching agents often normalises prolactin without dopamine agonists. Never add cabergoline blindly against prescribed antipsychotics. This distinction changes management, so it should be settled early rather than after empirical treatment has already begun.
steps.say: Drug cause pathways liaise with psychiatry before altering antipsychotic treatment.

steps.tx: Galactorrhoea with normal prolactin and regular cycles needs only reassurance, termed **idiopathic galactorrhoea**. Breast stimulation perpetuates it and is discouraged. Thyroid function completes its short workup. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Idiopathic galactorrhoea with normal prolactin needs only reassurance.
